summary.text: NORDSKOT BRYGGE AS is a private limited company registered in Leinesfjord, founded 2006-09-12. Nordskot Brygge AS is registered for renting out its own or leased real estate, renting and selling boats and similar vessels, accommodation and food service and arranging experiences within tourism and conferences, and investing in shares. It was previously named EIRIK-BRYGGA AS until 2011-11-03. Its main industry code is 55.200: holiday and other short-stay accommodation. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 4 858 845 NOK and the annual result was 43 365 NOK; operating income was down from 4 876 566 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 226 747 NOK in 2024 to 43 365 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 5 561 642 NOK in 2024 to 5 605 007 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: John Åge Handberg (daglig leder and styrets leder), with 1 other board member. Its verified website is nordskotbrygge.no. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
